data.narrative:
Monumental is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public equity (ticker 277810.KQ) operating in the same sector and stage. The three closest private peers—Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity—provide the primary benchmarking reference.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses $32M (total raised as proxy) multiplied by a typical Series B step-up factor of 1.9x, yielding $61M. The peer-median method applies the median valuation of the three same-sector, same-stage comparables at $1.8B, with a range between $1.6B (Dexterity) and $2.0B (Generalist AI). These two approaches produce a wide implied range: $52M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $905M across both methods.

The substantial dispersion reflects a fundamental tension: stage-progression mechanics suggest a more modest valuation anchored to capital deployed, while peer comparables—particularly the Bedrock and Generalist AI valuations—imply significantly higher multiples on similar-stage robotics companies. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Monumental's technology differentiation or market traction justifies a position toward the upper peer range versus the lower capital-based floor. The $1.6B–$2.0B peer band warrants closer scrutiny against specific operational metrics.
